The engagement is purely temporary, for one year initially. how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application proforma attached to the notice and type it clearly.
Indicate your experience and the skills/instruments used, and give your contact numbers in the proforma.

Sign the form and attach all required documents (degree certificates, experience certificates, research papers DOI etc.). Number the supporting documents serially as Annexures and refer to them in the form at the relevant places.
Upload all the documents as a single merged PDF file.
Name the PDF file as NPP << Applicant First Name >>06122026.pdf.
Attach the PDF in the application available on https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 6 December 2026.

Degree certificates, experience certificates and research papers DOI.
Scanned copy of the SC/ST/OBC certificate, for category candidates.
Scanned copy of the NET/GATE certificate, if qualified, with date of passing.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The notice is an interview notification issued by ICAR-CIBA, Chennai, dated 25.11.2026. The post sits under an NPP project funded under the Central Corpus Fund-Indian Council of Agricultural Research (CCF ICAR). The notice describes the engagement as being on a purely temporary basis of the institute.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Expertise in statistical and econometric modelling, socio-economic survey analysis, vulnerability assessment and livelihood impact assessment. Experience in programming languages such as R, Python, SPSS or STATA. The notice gives a lower age limit of 21 years and an upper age limit of 45 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is as per Govt. of India norms. The notice does not print a date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Fisheries Economics/Agricultural Economics/Agricultural Statistics/ Fisheries Science or other relevant disciplines with minimum one year experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is Rs. 42,000/- per month (Consolidated). The engagement is on a purely temporary basis. The duration is one year initially and may be extended for a further period of two years (one year at a time) based on satisfactory performance, or co-terminus with the project (whichever is earlier).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIBA Young Professional – II
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application proforma attached to the notice and type it clearly. Indicate your experience and the skills/instruments used, and give your contact numbers in the proforma. Sign the form and attach all required documents (degree certificates, experience certificates, research papers DOI etc.). Number the supporting documents serially as Annexures and refer to them in the form at the relevant places. Upload all the documents as a single merged PDF file. Name the PDF file as NPP << Applicant First Name >>06122026.pdf. Attach the PDF in the application available on https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 6 December 2026. Applications without the required documents may be rejected. Degree certificates, experience certificates and research papers DOI. Scanned copy of the SC/ST/OBC certificate, for category candidates. Scanned copy of the NET/GATE certificate, if qualified, with date of passing. Scanned copies of certificates for university awards, medals or conference best presentation awards, if claimed. The application form also asks for research papers published in SCI journals (with citation), patents filed or granted, work experience in project/industry/aquaculture, thesis or dissertation title, an abstract (maximum 150 words) and a statement of purpose of maximum one page.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Communication will only be sent to shortlisted candidates for attending the interview. The date and time of the interview will be intimated to the shortlisted candidates by email. The mode of interview is a suitable online platform or offline mode. Candidates who receive the mail should appear for the online or offline interview at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai with the required documents. The notice does not describe how marks or shortlisting are decided.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CIBA Young Professional – II recruitment?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications for one post of Young Professional – II at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted on or before 6 December 2026 through https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Young Professional – II?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Fisheries Economics/Agricultural Economics/Agricultural Statistics/ Fisheries Science or other relevant disciplines with minimum one year experience is essential.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The lower age limit is 21 years and the upper age limit is 45 years. SC/ST/OBC candidates get relaxation as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Young Professional – II post?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 42,000/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed proforma, attach it and all documents as one merged PDF, and attach that PDF in the application on https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How should the PDF file be named?
faq.answer: The PDF file should be named NPP << Applicant First Name >>06122026.pdf.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed by email and attend an interview on an online platform or in offline mode at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on a purely temporary basis, for one year initially, extendable by a further two years (one year at a time) based on satisfactory performance, or co-terminus with the project (whichever is earlier).
